title: MultiStateImage
text: Display image reflecting input value, {Label} sets Block label position; {Connection} sets the signal to connect and display signal connection, {Scale Mode} sets how to scale image Fill with fixed aspect and {States} sets the match values with images to display scalar. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Connection
params.values: Signal to connect and display signal connection options

params.name: Scale Mode
params.values: Specify how to scale image Fill with fixed aspect ratio (default) | Fixed | Fill

params.name: States
params.values: Match values with images to display scalar and image

params.name: Label
params.values: Block label position Top (default) | Bottom | Hide
